expectationBasis: An issue detail page is the read view for a uniquely numbered work item within a repository — the top displays the number, a heading whose exact accessible name is the complete title without the issue number, and visible status text “Open” or “Closed”; the body displays the complete saved description as readable text; the right side displays assignees, labels, and milestone; and the bottom displays sections or records containing “Comment” or “Activity” text over time.
The seeded open issue title is `Improve onboarding` and its description is `Describe the onboarding improvement.`
After refreshing or reopening the same number from the list, the same title, status, metadata, and saved comments are displayed; users without repository access cannot view the detail content.
